lines.tts: They tried to erase these temples.
And every single time... they failed.

caps: Because here, *SHIVA* appeared | as an endless pillar of *LIGHT.*
lines.tts: Because here, Shiva appeared as an endless pillar of light.

caps: From the snows of *KEDARNATH*… | to the sea at *RAMESWARAM.*
lines.tts: Twelve Jyotirlingas. From the snows of Kedarnath... to the sea at Rameswaram.

caps: Raiders came for them. | They *LOOTED* the gold.
They *BROKE* the lingas. | They *BURNED* the halls.
lines.tts: Raiders came for them. They looted the gold. They broke the lingas. They burned the halls.

caps: In this series, | we will *NOT* say their names.
lines.tts: In this series... we will not say their names.

caps: We will name the ones | who *REBUILT* them.
lines.tts: We will name the ones who rebuilt them.
कुमारपाल. अहिल्याबाई होलकर. Ranoji Shinde. Maharaja Ranjit Singh. सरदार पटेल.

caps: Why does an *ARROW* at Somnath | point to the *SOUTH POLE?*
lines.tts: Why does an arrow at Somnath point to the South Pole?
Which Jyotirlinga do three states claim?
Which temple did one boulder save?
Twelve Jyotirlingas. Episode one: सोमनाथ. Tonight.

caps: Which *JYOTIRLINGA* | have *YOU* been to? | Comment it.
lines.tts: Which Jyotirlinga have you been to? Comment it.
